title: Universal SPR is not stable under standard tensor composition
target_falsified: Universal Single-Plane Reversibility (SPR) applied to the full composite generator matrix under ordinary tensor-product composition
theorem: If A has rank r on subsystem A and subsystem B has dimension d_B, then rank(A tensor I_B)=r d_B. Hence a rank-2 local single-plane generator becomes rank 2 d_B on the composite and violates rank<=2 for every d_B>=2.

scope.higher_dimension_formula_tests: spectator dimensions through 100 in unit tests

implication: Cycle027 SPR+NCR selects n=3 only for an irreducible single-system distinction space. Universal SPR cannot simultaneously be required on ordinary tensor-product composite spaces unless 'elementary' is factor-relative or the composition rule is changed.
possible_repair: Factor-local SPR: divide lifted support rank by spectator multiplicity, rank(A tensor I_B)/d_B=rank(A). This is composition-compatible for local lifts but does not by itself provide a new n=3 derivation.
novelty: No novelty claim. The decisive step uses the standard Kronecker rank identity.
prior_art: Zhang, H. (2013), On the Kronecker Products and Their Applications, Journal of Applied Mathematics, Article 296185.
